content.title: Spurs vs. Clippers: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (3/16/26)
content.text: The San Antonio Spurs (49–18) visit the LA Clippers (34–33) tonight at Intuit Dome in Inglewood. San Antonio returned to the win column Saturday with a 115–102 victory over the Charlotte Hornets, bouncing back from a narrow loss to the Denver Nuggets on Thursday that snapped a five-game winning streak. The Spurs remain one of the hottest teams in the league, having won 17 of their last 19 games, and are firmly locked in a two-team race for the top spot in the Western Conference. They currently trail the Oklahoma City Thunder by 3.5 games. In the win over Charlotte, Victor Wembanyama returned from a one-game absence and delivered a dominant all-around performance, finishing with 32 points, 12 rebounds, eight assists, and three blocks. San Antonio controlled the game from start to finish and limited the Hornets to just 38% shooting. The Clippers, meanwhile, enter tonight’s matchup after a 118–109 upset loss to the Sacramento Kings on Saturday. Sacramento shot a blistering 59% from the field, with DeMar DeRozan leading three Kings players who scored at least 23 points. Kawhi Leonard paced Los Angeles with 31 points, while newcomers Darius Garland and Bennedict Mathurin combined for 49. Leonard, however, exited early in the fourth quarter after turning his ankle with the Clippers trailing by 14. Los Angeles later cut the deficit to three with just over four minutes remaining, but that’s as close as they’d get. With Leonard sidelined, San Antonio holds a clear advantage. Expect the Spurs to control the tempo and secure a comfortable road win. Prediction: San Antonio Spurs 117, LA Clippers 108 Injury Report San Antonio Spurs Luke Kornet — Out (Knee) Dylan Harper — Out (Calf) David Jones Garcia — OFS (Ankle) LA Clippers Kawhi Leonard — Out (Ankle) Yanic Konan Niederhäuser — OFS (Foot) Bradley Beal — OFS (Hip) How to Watch Spurs vs. Clippers Tip-off for today’s Spurs-Clippers game is set for 10:00 PM Eastern / 9:00 PM Central / 7:00 PM Pacific at the Intuit Dome in Inglewood.
